description: This Java class implements a strategy for determining the maximum number of concurrent connections based on available JVM memory. It calculates the recommended limit considering the total max memory, memory required at startup, and memory per connection.

classes.name: MemoryBasedConnectionLimitStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that computes connection limits based on JVM memory parameters.

methods.name: getRecommendedLimit
methods.description: Calculates and returns the recommended maximum number of concurrent connections based on available memory.

methods.name: getResourcesDescription
methods.description: Provides a description of the resource constraints, specifically the maximum available memory in MB.
